EXCISE ORDINANCE
Excise Notification

IT is hereby notified that the following Order issued by the Minister in Charge of the subject of Finance, by virtue of thepowers vested in him by Section 32 of the Excise Ordinance (Chapter 52), as amended, and published as the ExciseNotificaton No. 11/2018 in the Extraordinary Gazette No. 2075/24 of June 13, 2018, in order to amend the ExciseNotification No. 03/2018, published in the Extraordinary Gazette No. 2054/41dated January 18, 2018 to revise theopening and closing hours of Toddy Taverns, specified in the Item No. 02 of Schedule of that Notification by substitutingthe opening and closing hours specified in the Schedule below with effect from June 13, 2018, was passed by Parliamenton September 20, 2018.
S. R. ATTYGALLE,
Secretary,Ministry of Finance and Economic Affaris.Ministry of Finance and Economic Affairs,Colombo 01,November 15, 2018.
